name: Sony PlayStation 3 family
summary: Explore PS3 phat, Slim and Super Slim hardware and the two non-interchangeable routes into homebrew: HEN on official or hybrid firmware, and CFW on CFW-capable consoles.

specs.cpu: Cell Broadband Engine: 1 PPE + 8 SPE (7 usable for games)
specs.memory: 256 MB XDR main memory + 256 MB GDDR3 graphics memory
specs.storage: Removable 2.5-inch SATA hard drive, 20 GB to 500 GB depending on model
specs.media: Blu-ray drive on all models; Super Slim uses a manual disc lid

variants.storage: 20 GB to 80 GB on early models; later phats up to 160 GB
variants.notes: CECHAxx through CECHQxx model groups (2006-2009). CECHA/B/C/E retain PlayStation 2 hardware or partial compatibility; later phats drop it. Expansion bay for a hard drive and network adapter on early models.

specs.media: Blu-ray drive; HDMI and AV multi-out

variants.storage: 120 GB to 320 GB depending on SKU
variants.notes: CECH-20xx through CECH-30xx model groups (2009-2012). Smaller, cooler case; no PlayStation 2 support.

variants.storage: 250 GB or 500 GB depending on SKU
variants.notes: CECH-40xx through CECH-43xx model groups (2012-2013). Top-loading disc lid, smallest case, no PlayStation 2 support.

specs.media: Blu-ray drive with manual lid; HDMI output

homebrew.name: PS3HEN
homebrew.firmware: PS3HEN v3.6.0 Supported Firmwares (checked 2026-10-29): CEX OFW 4.80-4.82, DEX OFW 4.82, CEX HFW 4.83.1-4.93.1, DEX HFW 4.84.2
homebrew.summary: Homebrew ENabler for PS3. It adds homebrew and plugin support without replacing the system firmware; on 4.83 and newer it needs the matching hybrid firmware (HFW) installed first.

compatibility.note: CEX official firmware 4.80, 4.81 and 4.82. PS3HEN separately lists DEX OFW 4.82; this list covers CEX only.
CEX hybrid firmware builds listed by PS3HEN; install the matching HFW before HEN. PS3HEN separately lists a DEX HFW 4.84.2 build, which this CEX list does not cover.

requirements: PS3 on one of the listed official or hybrid firmware builds.
For 4.83 and newer, the matching HFW image installed first.
The PS3HEN package and a USB drive for the install files.
warnings: HEN is not permanent: it is lost on reboot and must be re-enabled.
HEN and CFW steps are not interchangeable; do not mix the two guides.
PS3HEN says CFWs can be used for testing but are not recommended with HEN.

homebrew.name: HFW (hybrid firmware)
homebrew.firmware: Community CEX hybrid images for 4.83.1-4.93.1, credited to Joonie, habib and littlebalup in PS3HEN's list
homebrew.summary: Hybrid firmware that keeps the official base but adds the hooks PS3HEN needs on 4.83 and newer. It is a prerequisite for HEN on those versions, not a full custom firmware.

compatibility.note: CEX HFW builds listed by PS3HEN. Install the exact matching version; arbitrary hybrid images are not supported.

requirements: A CEX console on a compatible base firmware.
The exact HFW image matching the PS3HEN list.
warnings: HFW is still a signed base with patches; it is not CFW and does not provide permanent custom firmware features.
Installing any firmware image can fail; follow the project's instructions.

homebrew.name: CFW (custom firmware, e.g. Evilnat Cobra 4.93)
homebrew.firmware: Console-specific; Evilnat publishes 4.93 Cobra builds under 8.5/4.93/EVILNAT
homebrew.summary: A modified system firmware installed permanently on CFW-capable consoles. Whether a console can take CFW depends on its model and boot flash; the psdevwiki CFW list and per-model pages are the reference.

compatibility.note: No single verified CFW compatibility matrix is claimed. CFW capability is per console and boot flash; psdevwiki documents the CFW list, model pages and hardware flashers.

requirements: A verified NAND/NOR backup before any flash.
For many phat consoles, a hardware flasher and soldering work.
warnings: A failed or mismatched CFW flash can brick the console.
Installing CFW on a phat usually needs a hardware flasher.
CFW and HEN steps are not interchangeable.

homebrew.name: Hardware flashers (NAND/NOR)
homebrew.firmware: Reads and writes the boot flash; not a firmware version
homebrew.summary: Tools for reading and writing the PS3 boot flash. psdevwiki documents flasher models and the downgrading-with-hardware-flasher procedure; soldering and a verified backup are prerequisites.

compatibility.note: Hardware flashing is documented for phat consoles; exact model and flasher compatibility must be checked against psdevwiki.

requirements: A compatible flasher for the console's flash chip.
Soldering equipment and a verified NAND/NOR backup.
warnings: A bad flash can brick the console without a backup.
Remarrying a replaced Blu-ray drive is a separate hardware-service task.

homebrew.name: OtherOS / OtherOS++ (Linux)
homebrew.firmware: Official OtherOS ended with a 2010 firmware update; OtherOS++ is a CFW-side patch
homebrew.summary: Sony's official OtherOS let early phat consoles boot Linux. Community OtherOS++ restores a Linux-capable boot on CFW-capable consoles only; it is not a supported or current install path.

compatibility.note: Official OtherOS was on early phat consoles only. Community OtherOS++ requires a CFW-capable console.

requirements: A Linux distribution and storage prepared per the community guide.
warnings: Official OtherOS was removed by a firmware update in 2010.
OtherOS++ is a community patch, not a supported Linux distribution.

homebrew.name: webMAN MOD
homebrew.firmware: Custom firmware 4.46-4.93, Evilnat 4.87.2-4.93, or PS3HEN on HFW 4.84-4.93, as listed upstream.
homebrew.summary: A homebrew plugin for a jailbroken PS3 with a web server, FTP server, file manager, ISO mounting, gamepad emulation and PS3MAPI. It is the maintained fork of the original webMAN/sMAN.

compatibility.note: README lists CFW 4.46-4.93, Evilnat 4.87.2-4.93 and PS3HEN/HFW 4.84-4.93; the versions here are the PS3HEN/HFW range.

requirements: A PS3 running custom firmware with Cobra, Evilnat/REBUG firmware, or PS3HEN on HFW.
The matching webMAN MOD package for the firmware route.
warnings: webMAN MOD is a plugin, not a jailbreak: it adds nothing on stock official firmware.
Features vary by firmware route and Cobra/Mamba availability.
homebrew.availability: Open source; releases and wiki published by the project.

homebrew.name: Mamba
homebrew.firmware: No firmware matrix published. The README documents booting on REBUG 4.84.2 and was originally tested on CFW 4.46 and 4.53; Mamba is loaded by a payload loader on an already jailbroken console.
homebrew.summary: A payload derived from Cobra that adds CFW syscalls (LV2 and LV1 peek/poke, syscall 8), ISO and network ISO mounting, kernel plugins and PS3MAPI. It is loaded by a payload loader such as webMAN MOD, IRISMAN or the Mamba/PRX loader; it does not jailbreak a console on its own.

compatibility.note: The README gives no supported-firmware list: it documents loading on REBUG 4.84.2 and names CFW 4.46 and 4.53 as originally tested. Payload builds are per firmware, so check the release that matches your CFW or HEN.

requirements: A PS3 already running custom firmware or PS3HEN.
A payload loader that can load Mamba (webMAN MOD, IRISMAN or the Mamba/PRX loader).
The Mamba payload build matching the installed firmware.
warnings: Mamba is a payload, not a jailbreak: it adds nothing on stock official firmware.
On REBUG, the README says to disable the Cobra payload before loading Mamba.
Syscall and feature support vary by firmware build.
homebrew.availability: Open source (GPL v3); payloads published by the project.

homebrew.name: Sony PS3 system software update and reinstall
homebrew.summary: Sony's official instructions for updating or reinstalling PS3 system software. Reinstalling removes HEN and CFW and does not downgrade.

compatibility.note: Official PS3 recovery and update track shared by the whole family; reinstall does not accept older firmware.

requirements: FAT32 USB drive with the PS3 update PUP in the documented folder; use Recovery Mode as Sony documents.
warnings: Reinstalling PS3 system software removes HEN and CFW.
Reinstalling does not downgrade the console.
Sony's 4.93 update renews the Blu-ray player encryption key.

homebrew.name: PS3 firmware rollback status - no verified general method
homebrew.firmware: No general rollback firmware support established
homebrew.summary: Records the documented PS3 downgrade limit: Sony's tools are forward-only. HFW and CFW are separate routes; neither is a general rollback to an arbitrary older firmware.

compatibility.note: No PS3 model-specific rollback method was verified; Sony's update and reinstall paths do not accept older firmware.

warnings: An archived older PUP is not a downgrade method.
Reinstalling does not downgrade.
Hardware flashing is a soldered intervention, not a user rollback.
